text: No 8px hits. Look for admin token/label in UI sources with any font size, in canvas, work-os and engineering-ops src dirs.
command: cd /work && timeout 20 grep -rniE 'admin' apps/canvas apps/work-os apps/engineering-ops --include=*.tsx --include=*.css --include=*.ts -l --exclude-dir=node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; ls apps/canvas apps/work-os
